First, we apply the sum rule and write our repeated integral as follows:

$$
{\int }_{-1}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{1}3{x}^{2}\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}z-{\int }_{-1}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{1}4{y}^{3}\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}z-{\int }_{-1}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{1}2z\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}z
$$

Since the domain of integration $R=[0,1]\times [0,2]\times [-1,1]$ is a rectangular box, and each integrand can be expressed as $f(x)\cdot g(y)\cdot h(z),$ we can rewrite our sum of repeated integrals as follows:

$$
{\int }_{0}^{1}3{x}^{2}\,\text{d}x{\int }_{0}^{2}\text{d}y{\int }_{-1}^{1}\text{d}z-{\int }_{0}^{1}\text{d}x{\int }_{0}^{2}4{y}^{3}\,\text{d}y{\int }_{-1}^{1}\text{d}z-{\int }_{0}^{1}\text{d}x{\int }_{0}^{2}\text{d}y{\int }_{-1}^{1}2z\,\text{d}z
$$

Let's evaluate each of these separately:

- For the first product, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}3{x}^{2}\,\text{d}x{\int }_{0}^{2}\text{d}y{\int }_{-1}^{1}\text{d}z & =[{x}^{3}]_{0}^{1}\cdot (2-0)\cdot (1-(-1)) \\  & =1\cdot 2\cdot 2 \\  & =4.\end{aligned}
$$

- For the second product, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}\text{d}x{\int }_{0}^{2}4{y}^{3}\,\text{d}y{\int }_{-1}^{1}\text{d}z & =(1-0)\cdot [{y}^{4}]_{0}^{2}\cdot (1-(-1)) \\  & =1\cdot 16\cdot 2 \\  & =32.\end{aligned}
$$

- For the third product, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}\text{d}x{\int }_{0}^{2}\text{d}y{\int }_{-1}^{1}2z\,\text{d}z & =(1-0)\cdot (2-0)\cdot [{z}^{2}]_{-1}^{1} \\  & =1\cdot 2\cdot 0 \\  & =0.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we conclude that

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{-1}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{1}(3{x}^{2}-4{y}^{3}-2z)\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}z=4-32-0=-28.\end{aligned}
$$
